parameters.name: GroupDesc
parameters.description: The description of the group. The description must be 1 to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the group. The ID is the globally unique identifier (GUID) for the group.

parameters.name: GroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the group.

If you set the value to **LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC**, a dynamic group is queried. If you do not specify this parameter, a static group is queried by default.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-device-group --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --group-id W16X8Tvdosec0000 --group-desc test2 --group-type LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot UpdateDeviceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --GroupType LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC --GroupDesc test2 --GroupId W16X8Tvdosec0000
